correctness.rationale: If the two distinguished directions were dependent for an entire planar periodic profile, positivity of \(p_\alpha\) makes \(\Lambda_\alpha Y_0\) nonzero and yields \(Y_0'=a\Lambda_\alpha Y_0\). Integration confines the orbit to one quasi-homogeneous scaling ray. The balance equation and exact scaling law for \(f_{\alpha,k}\) then reduce motion on that ray to the scalar autonomous equation \(u'=-1/k+b e^{ku}\). Periodicity forces a periodic scalar solution, hence an equilibrium, contradicting nonconstancy. Proposition 4.3, Remark 4.4 and Corollary 4.5 of arXiv:2610.05354v1 then give the two multipliers, and dimension two makes them exhaustive. Theorem 5.1 supplies the stated blow-up asymptotic.
